_comment: Log noise judged harmless. Each pattern is a regex matched against '<logger>: <message>'. Keep a note saying why it's harmless.

known.pattern: ^mixin: Reference map '.*' for .* could not be read
known.note: normal on production NeoForge; refmaps are only needed in dev environments

known.pattern: ^probejs: Error while loading class .*just one class
known.note: ProbeJS scanning optional compat classes for mods that aren't installed (JEI, REI, TOP)

known.pattern: ^cpw\.mods\.modlauncher\.TransformerClassWriter: Failed to find class (mezz/jei|me/shedaniel|mcjty/theoneprobe)
known.note: logged during a ProbeJS dump while it loads JEI/REI/TOP compat classes; harmless

known.pattern: ^KubeJS: Plugin .* does not have required mod '.*' loaded, skipping
known.note: KubeJS addon compat for mods not in the pack

known.pattern: ^KubeJS Server: (Due to the way Minecraft resource loading works|You can still see the full log)
known.note: KubeJS informational notice about server.log

known.pattern: ^GTCEu: FluidStorageKey\{gtceu:liquid\} already has an associated fluid for material gtceu:(water|lava|milk)
known.note: GregTech reusing the vanilla/NeoForge fluid for these materials

known.pattern: ^GTCEu: Predicate$
known.note: multiblock preview predicate with no candidates (EMI preview only)

known.pattern: ^net\.minecraft\.core\.MappedRegistry: Not all defined tags for registry .* are present in data pack: c:mineable/
known.note: GregTech tool-type tags (crowbar, hammer, knife, saw) that nothing defines

known.pattern: ^EMI: \[EMI\] (The following EMI classes have mixins|.* is tainted by)
known.note: GregTech and ModularUI patch EMI for their integration

known.pattern: ^net\.neoforged\.jarjar\.selection\.JarSelector: Attempted to select a dependency jar for JarJar which was passed in as source
known.note: a mod also ships a library that's installed separately; the standalone jar wins

known.pattern: ^net\.minecraft\.server\.packs\.VanillaPackResourcesBuilder: Assets URL .* uses unexpected schema
known.note: NeoForge's union filesystem; vanilla warns about the URL scheme

known.pattern: ^oshi\.util\.
known.note: system performance-counter probing on Windows

known.pattern: ^net\.minecraft\.client\.renderer\.ShaderInstance: Shader rendertype_entity_translucent_emissive could not find sampler named Sampler2
known.note: vanilla shader warning

known.pattern: ^io\.netty\.bootstrap\.Bootstrap: Unknown channel option 'SO_BROADCAST'
known.note: LAN discovery socket option unsupported on Windows

known.pattern: ^patchouli: Recipe minecraft:clay \(of type minecraft:crafting\) not found
known.note: TFC field guide page links a vanilla recipe that TFC removes

known.pattern: ^mixin: (Error loading class: (net/irisshaders|org/jetbrains/annotations)/|@Mixin target net\.irisshaders\.\S+ was not found)
known.note: optional compat mixins referencing classes that are not in the pack (Iris; JetBrains annotations)

known.pattern: ^dev\.ryanhcode\.sable\.Sable: NOTE: Sable is loaded with Flywheel
known.note: Sable's standing notice about Flywheel (bundled with Create); only matters if rendering bugs show up

known.pattern: ^net\.minecraft\.server\.dedicated\.DedicatedServer: (\*\*\*\* SERVER IS RUNNING IN OFFLINE|The server will make no attempt to authenticate|While this makes the game possible to play without internet|To change this, set \"online-mode\")
known.note: the test server runs offline on 127.0.0.1 by design

known.pattern: ^net\.minecraft\.client\.server\.LanServerPinger: LanServerPinger: Invalid argument: sendto
known.note: LAN broadcast unavailable; irrelevant

known.pattern: ^KubeJS: Plugin .*Client.* does not load on server side, skipping
known.note: client-only KubeJS plugin skipped on a dedicated server, as intended

known.pattern: ^net\.minecraft\.core\.MappedRegistry: Not all defined tags for registry .*minecraft:item.* are present in data pack: almostunified:
known.note: Almost Unified's EMI-hiding tags are referenced but empty until unification rules use them

known.pattern: ^GTCEu: duplicate loot table: gtceu:blocks/
known.note: GregTech nightly re-adds its generated block loot tables on /reload and logs each one; startup is clean (upstream bug, harmless)

known.pattern: ^net\.neoforged\.fml\.common\.asm\.RuntimeDistCleaner: Attempted to load class net/minecraft/client/player/LocalPlayer for invalid dist DEDICATED_SERVER
known.note: TFC probing for a client recipe manager on a dedicated server; TFC logs 'This is fine' right after

known.pattern: ^net\.neoforged\.fml\.common\.asm\.RuntimeDistCleaner: Attempted to load class net/minecraft/client/(multiplayer/ClientLevel|gui/components/Button) for invalid dist DEDICATED_SERVER
known.note: optional client-side compat (most likely Sable's and EMI's) touching client classes on a dedicated server; caught, the server carries on. Revisit if a server crash names these classes

known.pattern: ^net\.minecraft\.world\.item\.crafting\.RecipeManager: Skipping recipe \S+, not a json object
known.note: recipes switched off by a false condition: vanilla ones TFC disables, and TFC's 5-8 clay ball recipes the pack disables (logged once a KubeJS recipe script is present)

known.pattern: ^GTCEu: failed to add recipe from staging into lookup DB: gtceu:
known.note: iron and wrought-iron variants of a GregTech recipe became identical after unification (iron = wrought iron); GregTech keeps one of each pair

known.pattern: ^net\.neoforged\.neoforge\.common\.CommonHooks: The following mods have version differences that were not resolved
known.note: opening a world last saved with other mod versions (after a pack update); shown once

known.pattern: ^patchouli: Could not locate JEI keybindings
known.note: Patchouli's show-recipe shortcut in books looks for JEI's keys, which EMI handles; EMI's R/U keys work

known.pattern: ^net\.dries007\.tfc\.TerraFirmaCraft: Experimental world gen
known.note: TFC's joke warning about the experimental world-gen settings screen; harmless

known.pattern: ^mezz\.jei\.library\.plugins\.vanilla\.ingredients\.ItemStackListFactory: Item Group has no display items .*KubeJS
known.note: KubeJS's creative tab is empty because the pack adds no items

known.pattern: ^mixin: Method overwrite conflict for (getTemperature|removeIf) in modernfix-modernfix\.mixins\.json:.* previously written by net\.caffeinemc\.mods\.lithium\.
known.note: ModernFix and Lithium ship the same fix (biome temperature cache, chunk ticket removal); Lithium's copy applies and ModernFix skips its own

known.pattern: ^mixin: Static binding violation: PRIVATE @Overwrite method \w+ in modernfix-modernfix\.mixins\.json:perf\.tag_id_caching\.
known.note: ModernFix's tag id cache overwrites a public method with a private one; Mixin keeps it public, which is what ModernFix expects

known.pattern: ^ModernFix: (Initial datapack load|Dedicated server|Game) took [\d.]+ s
known.note: ModernFix's load-time report, logged as a warning; informational

known.pattern: ^net\.minecraft\.world\.level\.storage\.loot\.LootDataType: Couldn't parse element ResourceKey\[minecraft:root / minecraft:loot_table\]:(dndecor|railways|create_connected|create_factory_logistics):blocks/\S+ - Unknown registry key in ResourceKey\[minecraft:root / minecraft:item\]
known.note: loot tables for compat blocks that only register with mods not in the pack (Design n Decor's and Create Connected's Dye Depot colours, Steam 'n' Rails tracks for other mods' woods, Factory Logistics' Mekanism gauge)

known.pattern: ^mixin: Discarding @Unique public method \w+ in copycats-(neoforge|common)\.mixins\.json:
known.note: Copycats+ mixes methods into its own copycat classes that already define them; Mixin keeps the class's own

known.pattern: ^KubeJS Server: \w+\.java#\d+: Failed to parse recipe 'woodencog:mixing/lye_alabaster_bricks\[create:mixing\]'.* Falling back to vanilla
known.note: KubeJS's Create schema can't read this recipe's fluid ingredient; it falls back to the game's own parse, which loads it fine

known.pattern: ^dev\.ryanhcode\.sable\.Sable: Failed to apply tag physics properties\. Unknown block: copycats:copycat_catwalk
known.note: Sable ships physics properties for a Copycats+ block this Copycats+ version doesn't have

known.pattern: ^mixin: (Error loading class: (me/jellysquid/mods/lithium/common/ai/pathing/PathNodeDefaults|xfacthd/framedblocks/)|@Mixin target xfacthd\.framedblocks\.)
known.note: optional compat mixins for mods not in the pack (Copycats+ for Radium, Big Cannons for FramedBlocks)

known.pattern: ^net\.minecraft\.server\.packs\.PathPackResources: Non \[a-z0-9_.-\] character in namespace LICENSE in pack
known.note: a mod jar ships a LICENSE file in its data folder; ignored

known.pattern: ^(net\.minecraft\.tags\.TagLoader|KubeJS): Couldn't load tag (woodencog:unburnable|tfc:unfired_pottery) as it is missing following references
known.note: Woodencog tags its fireclay crucible, which this Woodencog version doesn't register

known.pattern: ^net\.minecraft\.core\.MappedRegistry: Not all defined tags for registry ResourceKey\[minecraft:root / minecraft:item\] are present in data pack: tfc:unfired_pottery$
known.note: follows from the Woodencog crucible tag above

known.pattern: ^net\.neoforged\.neoforge\.registries\.DataMapLoader: Found data map file for non-existent data map type 'create_dragons_plus:
known.note: an addon ships fan-catalyst data for Create: Dragons Plus, which isn't in the pack

known.pattern: ^net\.dries007\.tfc\.util\.MetalItem: Item (minecraft:iron_ingot|tfc:metal/ingot/wrought_iron) was inferred to match multiple metals
known.note: TFC picks ingot-pile textures from c:ingots/* tags, and iron ingots are in both c:ingots/iron and c:ingots/wrought_iron; config/tfc-server.toml excludes c:ingots/iron, but the server's first data load runs before server configs are read (it applies from the next reload, and on clients)

known.pattern: ^spark: Timed out waiting for world statistics
known.note: spark gathers world statistics in the background; the short-lived test server stops before it finishes
